The Knight breaks down the stone door at King's Pass to enter Dirtmouth from the west.
A lift east of the town centre goes up to Crystal Peak; the activation lever is located near the mines' entrances.
East of Dirtmouth town centre lies a graveyard.
The graveyard leads to a stone door barring a cave; a Simple Key is required to open it.
Dirtmouth's Stag Station is locked from the inside but reachable from any other Stag Station in the network.
Elder Hu's memorial is located above the gates to the City of Tears, placing the boss encounter at the boundary between these zones
Elder Hu travelled from Mantis Village where he was slain; his memorial rests in Dirtmouth near City of Tears

Greenpath is a location within Hallownest, reachable as part of the world map
Following Hornet leads to the toll bridge area; a gate blocks upward passage, with lever on the far side
The player traverses the flower/fungus-covered ground platforms of the Forgotten Crossroads, passing large oval stone door structures to reach the False Knight's arena.

Bottom-right section of Royal Waterways; requires defeating Dung Defender and using Crystal Heart to cross crystal platforms

Door at the very bottom of Ancient Basin, opened with King's Brand
Platforming section upward through void siblings leads to lighthouse canopy at the top
Right side of the falling void liquid room, accessible after lighthouse is activated to eliminate void liquid
